title: 第342章 秘境结束
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

韩林将战场收拾了一下，见柳三春过来，简单聊了几句，两人就开始采集凝元草。

这次柳三春不再说韩林不干人事了，甚至还帮忙把那些没成熟的凝元草，全部采集起来。

半炷香后，两人走回原地，将各自采集的凝元草合在一起盘点。

最后惊喜地发现，完全成熟的凝元草数量，竟达到了足足一百一十株。

至于没有完全成熟的，更是多达一千五百株。

这可把韩林高兴坏了，甚至一度觉得，这凝元草已经是没人要的大路货。

但实际上，却和他想的大相径庭。

因为凝元草这种东西，别说碧空岛了，就是放在整个归墟海，那也是极为罕见的灵药。

而且生长环境十分挑剔，一般人根本没法培植。

只是在聚元秘境现世之期，才有机会采摘到一些，而且数量也没有韩林想象中那么多。

毕竟大家都是只采集已经完全成熟的，不像他这样，就跟土匪进村差不多，直接来了个大扫荡。

相信这次过后，聚元秘境就是元气大伤了，即便再次开启，后面的人也不会有太大收获。

“柳道友，这是你应得的二十二株，剩下的我就收起来了。”韩林从成熟的凝元草堆里面，分出一部分递给柳三春。

“好，那我就不客气了！”

柳三春搓了搓手，兴奋地接了过来，笑道：“这是我进入聚元秘境以来，最大的一次收获。”

“而且这还是沾了韩兄的光，要不然，我恐怕一株也没有。”

“你在遇到我之前，没有采到聚元草吗？”韩林将剩下的聚元草全部装了起来，略显意外道。

柳三春感叹道，“没有，我实力太弱了，根本打不过守护兽，所以就算

“那倒也是。”

韩林点点头，就站起身来，“也不知道秘境还有多久结束，你接下来有什么打算吗？”

“据说聚元秘境一般会持续半年，但并不固定，有可能早些也有可能晚些。”

柳三春想了下，“如今已经过去大半，我估计凝元宝地也被其他人探的差不多了，没必要再跑来跑去的，要不我们就在周围打打小怪，历练一下吧？”

“也行。”

韩林觉得此行收获已经相当不错，没必要再去冒险。

须知人外有人，天外有天，若是不小心把自己交待在这里，那就亏大了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Han Lin cleaned up the battlefield and saw Liu Sanchun coming over. After a brief chat, the two began to collect Yuan Yuan grass.

This time Liu Sanchun no longer said that Han Lin was idle, and even helped collect all the immature Ning Yuan grass.

After half a stick of incense, the two walked back to the original place and took stock of the Ning Yuan grass they had collected together.

In the end, I was pleasantly surprised to find that the number of fully mature Ning Yuan grass reached a full one hundred and ten.

As for those that are not fully mature, there are as many as 1,500 plants.

This made Han Lin extremely happy. He even felt that this Ning Yuan Grass was already a popular commodity that no one wanted.

But in reality, it was quite different from what he thought.

Because things like Ning Yuan Grass, let alone Blue Sky Island, are extremely rare elixirs in the entire Guixu Sea.

Moreover, the growing environment is very picky and ordinary people cannot cultivate it at all.

It was only when the Juyuan Secret Realm appeared that I had the opportunity to pick some, and the quantity was not as large as Han Lin imagined.

After all, everyone only collects the ones that are fully mature. Unlike him, it is almost like bandits entering the village and directly carrying out a large-scale sweep.

I believe that after this time, the vitality of Juyuan Secret Realm will be greatly damaged. Even if it is opened again, the people behind will not gain much.

"Fellow Daoist Liu, these are the twenty-two plants you deserve. I will keep the rest." Han Lin separated a portion from the pile of mature Ningyuan grass and handed it to Liu Sanchun.

"Okay, then I'm welcome!"

Liu Sanchun rubbed his hands, took it over excitedly, and said with a smile: "This is my biggest gain since entering the Juyuan Secret Realm."

"And this is thanks to Brother Han. Otherwise, I might not have even one."

"Didn't you collect the Juyuan Herb before you met me?" Han Lin packed up all the remaining Ju Yuan Herb and said slightly surprised.

Liu Sanchun sighed, "No, I'm too weak to defeat the guardian beast, so even if

"That's true."

Han Lin nodded and stood up, "I don't know how long it will take for the secret realm to end. What are your plans next?"

"It is said that Juyuan Secret Realm usually lasts for half a year, but it is not fixed. It may be earlier or later."

Liu Sanchun thought for a moment, "Now that more than half of the time has passed, I estimate that the Ning Yuan Bao Land has been explored by others. There is no need to run around anymore. How about we just fight the monsters around and get some experience?""

"Alright."

Han Lin felt that the harvest from this trip was quite good and there was no need to take risks again.

It should be noted that there are people outside the world, and there is a sky outside the world. If you accidentally leave yourself here, you will suffer a big loss.
